entities.name: Kaluzax
entities.description: An Izzet League observosphere pilot trapped in the implosion event horizon, becoming the plague herald haunting the Schism.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Designer of the mana-implosion device experiment.

entities.name: Vazozav
entities.description: Chief Observer who headed the mission.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: The region where the experiment took place.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: Clans who attacked the observosphere and named Kaluzax the kuga mot.

entities.name: Schism
entities.description: A disaster created by Kaluzax's trapped sphere.

events.summary: During the mission in Utvara a Gruul aerial attack damaged the sphere and Kaluzax could not escape the experiment in time.
events.quote: the sphere was damaged during a Gruul aerial attack

events.summary: Kaluzax and his sphere were trapped in the implosion event horizon, directly causing the Schism; he became the kuga mot.
events.quote: directly causing the creation of the Schism

relations.note: He was an Izzet League pilot.
